title: 1329 Support new React table with column filter

issues.title: React table column filter
issues.body:
In our custom-created table we had a column filter, our own version of this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/151531526-08260884-712a-448c-96b4-ca2cb6d217f2.png)

We've switched to the react data table component, but it doesn't have a column filter. There is a [feature request](https://github.com/jbetancur/react-data-table-component/issues/994) for a column filter.

This issue covers the effort to look at the react-data-table-component sources, and to decide if it is feasible to add a column filter.  

I _imagine_ the API looking like this: by setting a "filterValues" field to "strings", the table would provide a context menu in the column header that shows a list of unique values in that column. The user selects values of interest, and then Apply.  (Note: in the future a "numeric" option could also be added, which allows the user to provide a filter range for numeric data).

If it does look possible we would submit a PR to the `react-data-table-component` project.
